description: This Java source file defines data transfer objects and API schemas for the Tax Group API in the Fineract project, including request and response models with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: TaxGroupApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container class holding nested static classes that define the schema models for the Tax Group API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetTaxesGroupResponse
classes.description: Represents the response schema for retrieving a tax group, including its ID, name, and associated tax associations.

classes.name: GetTaxesGroupTaxAssociations
classes.description: Models the associations of tax components within a tax group, including start date and nested tax component details.

classes.name: GetTaxesGroupTaxComponent
classes.description: Details of individual tax components within associations, including ID and name.

classes.name: PostTaxesGroupRequest
classes.description: Represents the request payload for creating a new tax group, including name, locale, date format, and tax components.

classes.name: PostTaxesGroupTaxComponents
classes.description: Details for each tax component included in the creation request, like tax component ID and start date.

classes.name: PostTaxesGroupResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a tax group, mainly returning the resource ID.

classes.name: PutTaxesGroupTaxGroupIdRequest
classes.description: Represents the request payload for updating a tax group's details, including its name, locale, and tax components.

classes.name: PutTaxesGroupTaxComponents
classes.description: Details of tax components when updating a tax group, including IDs, tax component ID, and end date.

classes.name: PutTaxesGroupTaxGroupIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating a tax group, including resource ID and changes made.

classes.name: PutTaxesGroupChanges
classes.description: Details of changes in the tax group after an update, including added and modified components.

classes.name: PutTaxesGroupModifiedComponents
classes.description: Details of individual modified components in a tax group update, including end date and tax component ID.

methods.name: TaxGroupApiResourceSwagger
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation, serving as a namespace for nested classes.
